guardrails: none: no citation gate, no critic, fix not forced to need approval
rationale: checkoutservice has by far the largest anomaly: CPU rose from 0.39 to 5.07 (+1189%, z=+62), with sockets and memory also up (z=+28.8 and +16.7) and its own latency-90/50 elevated, while no other service shows a comparable shift. The slowest traces go through frontend/currency/productcatalog/recommendation rather than checkoutservice and no logs or error spans exist, so CPU as the primary fault (versus socket or mem) is inferred from the largest-magnitude metric, not directly confirmed.

proposed_fix.description: Inspect checkoutservice for the cause of the CPU spike (runaway work, connection leak driving sockets), and check its CPU requests/limits and throttling. Restart or scale out its replicas only after confirming it is safe, and do not change limits until the cause is understood.
